fix.template: Diagnose and fix the most recent CLI error. Read ~/.opencode-error-log.json, identify root cause, and apply the fix.
fix.description: Diagnose and fix the most recent CLI error using the log monitor

doc-aware.template: Load relevant docs for the given task area (frontend, backend, core, sdk, infra, cli). Read the doc map in .opencode/agents/doc-aware-engineer.md, then load the docs.
doc-aware.description: Load relevant project docs before making changes

ui-fix.template: Read the UI error log at ~/.opencode-ui-error-log.json and the live backend errors at http://localhost:8000/errors/recent. Diagnose the most recent frontend error, identify the file and root cause, and apply a fix.
ui-fix.description: Diagnose and fix the most recent frontend UI error using the UI error watcher

error-fixer.description: Diagnoses and fixes errors detected in CLI logs.

doc-aware-engineer.description: Reads project manuals and docs before making changes.

ui-error-fixer.description: Diagnoses and fixes frontend UI errors.
